title: Every panel visitor downloads the whole AI Assistant even though nobody can see it
what: The admin app loads the AI Assistant's code (about 6,800 lines: answers, drafts, voice, credits, cards) as part of its first download for everyone: desk staff, trainers, the demo gym, and today every owner too, because the live server does not have the assistant switched on yet. Nothing in the admin app is loaded later on demand, so this weight is paid on every first open on a slow phone connection. The panel itself has no speed score (it needs a login), so the real cost in seconds is not measured.
expected: The assistant's code downloads only when an owner who can use it opens it, so everyone else gets a lighter first load.
who: everyone who opens the admin app
how_often: every first open of the admin app
fix_line: Load the assistant's screens only when the assistant is switched on and opened

title: The Today AI card works out all its ideas again every 30 seconds for no reason
what: The Today screen's AI card goes through every member (birthdays, plans ending, stopped coming, win back) again each time the panel's clock ticks, every 30 seconds, although none of those ideas depend on the minute. On a gym with 500 or more members on a cheap phone this is wasted work while the Today screen sits open.
expected: The ideas are worked out again only when the members, plans, visits or the day change.
how_often: every 30 seconds while Today is open
fix_line: Drop the clock from what makes the Today ideas recount
